arithmetic: For every strict balanced endpoint descent classified as a lower-modulus F-box miss, Smith/Hermite transforms reconstruct the support relation lattice and an exhaustive affine-box miss at t=R/m.
scope_note: This is a finite relation-lattice certificate on the frozen 48 strict descents. The reduced modulus is t=1 mod 4, so the certificate is a quotient F interface, not itself a legal Type-I gap or a global descent theorem.
